goals: Explain meaningful changes in sales/traffic/conversion with evidence-ranked hypotheses.
Prevent false causal claims; always separate confirmed facts from inference.
Hand off to recommendation engine with explicit confidence and prerequisites.

pipeline.purpose: Convert source records into canonical BusinessEvents with validation + dedupe.
rules: Normalize timestamps to ISO; treat Woo *_gmt without timezone suffix as UTC.
Attach provenance: source_record_ref, definition_version, freshness_as_of, coverage_start/end, completeness.
Reject events missing required fields for their event type; emit data-quality events instead (schema_changed/coverage_partial).

pipeline.purpose: Resolve analysis window for a dashboard range.
rules: Use inclusive start/end in Pacific day for commerce windows.
Record resolved range in explanation context.
If requested range extends outside proven coverage for required sources, degrade to unknown/insufficient evidence.

baselines.definition: Immediately preceding window of equal length.
Same weekday-aligned window one week prior.
Same period last year (if history supports).

pipeline.purpose: Detect meaningful changes (deltas) that require explanation.

signals.source: Derived: orders / sessions (only when both proven)

pipeline.purpose: Detect outliers requiring special treatment (e.g., original-art sale).

methods.description: Median absolute deviation based z-score on daily revenue buckets.
If single order > X% of window revenue, flag for segmentation.

pipeline.purpose: Generate candidate causes for each delta.

retrieval.notes: If joins are unavailable, candidates remain possible with low confidence.

pipeline.purpose: Rank evidence supporting each candidate cause.

hard_rules: Never mark a cause as confirmed unless evidence is confirmed and coverage is complete.
Never attribute revenue to Meta/Email unless attribution requirements satisfied.
If Woo completeness is unknown, do not generate revenue-based causal claims.

pipeline.purpose: Test alternative explanations and handle confounds.
rules: If multiple candidates plausibly explain delta, keep top 2-3 with confidence labels.
If data is incomplete, downgrade confidence and surface missing evidence explicitly.
For outliers, produce segmented explanation: baseline + outlier-separated view.
confirmed requires: exact telemetry + complete coverage + deterministic definition.
strongly_supported requires: multiple agreeing signals + acceptable coverage.
likely/possible used for plausible correlations; must include alternative explanations.
insufficient_evidence when required sources are stale/partial/unknown.

pipeline.purpose: Render explanation text with provenance and allowed language.
must_not_include: absolute causal claims without confirmed evidence

insufficient_evidence_behavior: If insufficient_evidence, generate only data-quality remediation recommendations (refresh ingestion, fix stale source)

non_negotiables: Do not destabilize Woo telemetry system.
All revenue explanations must reference definition_version and coverage.
